title: How to Edit the Website Email Signature | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Edit the Website Email Signature Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052157 The "General" section of the General Settings can be used to add a signature for the default system emails: This section will only edit the default website emails. There is also an option to add a different signature for the admin operator in the admin settings: Editing Admin Operators FROALA Text Editor: Versions and their Upload Functionalities Froala Editor - Tables For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
